newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish guitarist Narciso Yepes dies aged 69.
newsitem.headline: Spanish guitarist Narciso Yepes dies aged 69.

text.p: Spanish guitarist Narciso Yepes died on Saturday in his native city of Lorca at the age of 69 after a long illness.
Yepes, considered one of the world's most skillful guitar players, will have his ashes scattered at a monastery in southern Spain where he often prayed.
Among his main interpretations was Spanish composer Joaquin Rodrigo's "Concert of Aranjuez" which he performed around the world.
He was the creator of a novel 10-string guitar which he used in many of his concerts.
He was forced to retire in 1993 after being diagnosed with cancer.
